cost_gate.measurement_boundary: Same synchronized warmed inference boundary; startup, fit wall, adapter state, optimizer state, and peak memory reported separately.
cost_gate.runtime_ratio: continued_adaptable_readout warmed runtime / continued_fixed_readout warmed runtime
cost_gate.training_cost: Both continued arms use the same fixed 3000-step/base schedule; report extra adapter preparation, optimizer state, training wall, and peak memory. A resource-guard failure stops the run and leaves the pilot unresolved; no additional unstated cost threshold is introduced.

decision_logic.adaptation_signal: Adaptable beats fixed on useful rule: report as mechanism-screening signal only; no automatic replacement, retraining, or sample expansion.
decision_logic.adaptation_useful_pilot: Primary Finance P0 useful rule passes either route, all four cell harm gates pass, rare/absent gate is PASS rather than UNKNOWN, and all-cell cost gate passes.
decision_logic.fit_only: Adaptable beats unchanged but not continued-fixed: attribute gain to continued fitting and retain no adaptation claim.
decision_logic.inconclusive: Optimization, cost, harm, rare support, or useful route unresolved: retain TRR8 reference and label adaptation question unresolved.

freeze_approval.scope: Decision criteria and proposed panel only; no method state, inventory, source selection, prediction, timing, or truth authorization.

frequency_analysis.natural_token_accuracy: Within each cell and frequency bin, natural token accuracy is sum(correct token positions) / sum(exposed token positions); paired source-record bootstrap resamples the numerator and denominator together. Do not replace this ratio with an unweighted mean of per-record stratum accuracies when exposure counts differ.

methods.context_role: The retained TRR-0006 reference is contextual and is not refit or used as a new primary pair.

multiplicity.primary_family: Finance public_base adaptable-versus-fixed with two predeclared routes, exact and token, each route alpha 0.025.
multiplicity.secondary: Pile public_base and both LoRA cells are safeguards/secondary diagnostics; unchanged-anchor versus fixed quantifies continuation effect.
multiplicity.separation: Domains, target conditions, frequency bins, and unchanged-anchor/context comparisons remain separate; no pooled score or 64-direction family.

panel.pairing: Each source is paired across public_base and public_lora_2601; target observations are not independent sources.

primary.exact_interval: Lower CP gain component minus upper CP loss component, each component tail alpha 0.0125.
primary.exact_rule: Useful pilot signal requires point difference >= +2 percentage points AND conservative paired CP gain-minus-loss lower bound > 0.
primary.positive_rule: A lower bound > 0 is positive evidence; positive below the point floor is reported separately and is not a useful-pilot signal.
primary.record_unit: One natural source record; target conditions remain paired within source.
primary.token_interval: Paired source-record bootstrap, token positions nested within records, seed 9009 and 10000 draws.
primary.token_rule: Useful pilot signal requires point difference >= +0.25 percentage points AND one-sided 97.5% paired source-record bootstrap lower bound > 0.

rare_token_safeguard.accuracy_definition: Natural token accuracy is sum(correct token positions) / sum(exposed token positions) within the cell and frequency bin; source-record bootstrap resamples recompute both sums.
rare_token_safeguard.bootstrap_unit: Resample source records; recompute numerator and denominator on every draw. Do not average per-record stratum accuracies when exposure counts differ.
rare_token_safeguard.fit_frequency_reference: TRR-0007 improved_public_bank exact post-BOS frequency bins in experiments/TRR-0009/planning/source_inventory.json.
rare_token_safeguard.insufficient_support: UNKNOWN/underpowered; no automatic pass and no pooling across domains, targets, or bins.
rare_token_safeguard.interval: For each of the eight cell-by-target-bin gates, one-sided 95% paired source-record bootstrap lower bound for natural token accuracy difference.

readout_adaptation.count_zero_branch: Not evaluated: absent vocabulary IDs have no correction parameter; no count_v=0 division or branch is evaluated, and absent IDs are not included in the supported-token mean.
readout_adaptation.design: Direct post-logit supported-token gain and bias: logit_v = base_logit_v * gain_v + bias_v for supported v; absent readout entries stay fixed.
readout_adaptation.memory_accounting: Report adapter weights, optimizer state, and peak memory separately; do not charge the unchanged frozen embedding as trainable adapter state.
readout_adaptation.regularization: The initialization gain=1 and bias=0 is separate from this penalty. The penalty is exactly 1e-4 * mean((1 + 4/sqrt(count_v)) * (raw_gain_v**2 + raw_bias_v**2)) over supported tokens; count_v is positive for every included fitting-bank token.

safeguards.exact_rule: Every cell one-sided 95% paired exact lower bound must be >= -5 percentage points.
safeguards.interpretation: Point estimates cannot clear a harm gate; an unresolved cell keeps the useful-pilot decision unresolved.
safeguards.token_rule: Every cell one-sided 95% paired source-record bootstrap lower bound must be >= -1 percentage point.

starting_state.initialization_equivalence: unchanged_anchor reproduces this state exactly; adaptable readout gain=1 and bias=0 before fitting.
starting_state.rationale: Use the published competent current-bank residual checkpoint because the improved-bank residual already reached 100% on its own 124371-position fitting bank; this is a single prefitting choice, not a sweep. The improved_public_bank remains the fitting/validation bank for both continued arms.

training.fit_bank: TRR-0007 improved_public_bank; same records, labels, sampler, validation opportunities, and decoder continuation schedule in both continued arms
training.readout_group: supported gain/bias scalar group uses LR 1e-3 because it starts at zero change; decoder parameters resume at base LR 2e-4
training.schedule: same 3000-step cosine schedule with seed 4005 and batch size 8; step zero eligible under earliest-max validation selection every 100 steps

training_review_pending: test exact frequency-weighted raw_gain/raw_bias zero-anchor penalty and bounded gain/bias implementation
recompute initially-wrong challenge from the selected starting checkpoint rather than the historical neutral model
verify step-zero eligibility and earliest-max validation selection every 100 steps
qualify the largest representative cell after code freeze and compute reservation

truth_and_freeze.after_truth: Truth is used only to score frozen outputs; no refit, routing, sample expansion, or threshold changes.
truth_and_freeze.before_truth: Freeze source identities, paired observations, all arm outputs, validation receipts, timing, and resource receipts before any truth opening.
truth_and_freeze.source_selection: starts only after this contract is owner-frozen and actual exclusion compatibility is reviewed
